summary: The 8-K filing by Prelude Therapeutics announces a press release and investor presentation regarding new preclinical data for its lead candidate, PRT13722, at the AACR Annual Meeting. It describes PRT13722 as a KAT6A degrader showing efficacy in HR+/HER2- breast cancer models and outlines plans for an IND filing in mid-2026 with a Phase 1 study expected in the second half of 2026. The filing is a routine disclosure of research progress and contains no special-situation corporate transaction, activist campaign, board changes, or capital restructuring.
